title: Checkout restricted to card and Link, and cancelling at period end, with stripe-node 14 (control)
notes: Negative control for stripe-23. Same task shape on stripe-node 14.0.0, where payment_method_types on the Checkout Session is the correct parameter and cancelling at period end is a subscription update. The model knows this version well; the pack arm must not do worse than baseline, and must not tempt the agent toward the v23 API.
